messages.content:
Risk: IP information in prompt (ID: atlas-ip-information-in-prompt)
Description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
Concern: Inclusion of such data might result in it being disclosed in the model output. In addition to accidental disclosure, prompt data might be used for other purposes like model evaluation and retraining, and might appear in their output if not properly removed.
Policy: Proprietary Technical Data

Axis: Privacy Violation (http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PrivacyViolation)
Roles: object
Subclasses:
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#UnauthorizedSurveillance: Unauthorized Surveillance
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthDataExposure: Health Data Exposure
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DirectIdentifierExposure: Direct Identifier Exposure
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#EmploymentDataExposure: Employment Data Exposure
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#FinancialDataExposure: Financial Data Exposure
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DigitalFootprintExposure: Digital Footprint Exposure

Axis: Intellectual Property (http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#IntellectualProperty)
Roles: object
